mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_lot (lot_no, product_code, qty, status, expiry_date, received_at, received_by) VALUES (#{lotNo}, #{productCode}, #{qty}, #{status}, #{expiryDate}, #{receivedAt}, #{receivedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT l.lot_no, l.product_code, l.qty, l.status, l.expiry_date, l.received_at, l.received_by FROM stock_lot l WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN product p ON p.product_code = l.product_code WHERE l.product_code = #{productCode} AND p.use_yn = 'Y' AND l.status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'HOLD') ORDER BY l.expiry_date, l.lot_no
